units.source_text: “再说，有的人自以为是诗人，便变成了诗迷。

en.t: Besides, some people think themselves poets and then become obsessed with poetry.

units.source_text: 所作的诗一开头就引用有趣的典故。

en.t: The poems they compose begin by citing some clever allusion.

units.source_text: 也不管对方感不感兴趣，就装模作样地念给人听。

en.t: Without caring whether the other person is interested, they recite them in an affected manner for others to hear.
This is truly a tiresome thing.

units.source_text: 受了赠诗而不唱和，便显得没有礼貌。

en.t: Yet if one receives a poem and does not answer it with another, one seems discourteous.

units.source_text: 于是不擅长此道的人就为难了。

en.t: So people who are not skilled in this art are put in a difficult position.

units.source_text: 尤其是在节日，例如五月端阳节，急于入朝参贺，忙得无暇思索的时候，

en.t: Especially on festival days, such as the fifth-month Tango festival, when one is hurrying to court to offer congratulations and is too busy to think,

units.source_text: 便千篇一律地拉着菖蒲的根为题，作些无聊的诗歌。

en.t: they all make the same dull poems, dragging in the roots of the sweet flag as their theme.

units.source_text: 又如在九月重阳节宴席上，凝思构想，制作艰深的汉诗。

en.t: Or again, at a banquet for the ninth-month Double Ninth festival, they ponder deeply and compose difficult Chinese poems.

units.source_text: 心无余暇之时，匆匆忙忙地取菊花的露珠来比拟骚人的泪水，

en.t: When the mind has no leisure, they hastily take the dew on chrysanthemums and compare it to a poet's tears,

units.source_text: 作诗赠人，要人唱和，实在是不合时宜的行径。

en.t: then compose poems to send to others and demand replies; this is truly behavior unsuited to the occasion.

units.source_text: 这些诗其实不要在那天发表，过后从容地看看，倒是富有情趣的。

en.t: Such poems should not really be presented on that very day; read later at leisure, they can instead have a certain charm.

units.source_text: 只因不合那天的时宜，不顾读者的障眼，贸然向人发表，就反而被人看轻了。

en.t: But because they are ill timed for that day, and because one presents them rashly without considering the reader's annoyance, one ends up being looked down on instead.

units.source_text: 无论何事，如果不了解何以必须如此，不明白时地情状，那么还是不要装模作样，卖弄风情，倒可平安无事。

en.t: In anything, if one does not understand why it must be done so, and does not grasp the circumstances of time and place, it is better not to put on airs or show off one's refinement; then one may pass safely enough.

units.source_text: 无论何事，即使心中知道，还是装作不知的好；

en.t: In anything, even if one knows something inwardly, it is better to pretend not to know;

units.source_text: 即使想讲话，十句之中还是留着一两句不讲的好。”

en.t: and even if one wants to speak, it is better to leave one or two words unsaid out of ten.”
